title: The Sirens
sub: Bind Odysseus to the mast, then row past the song

bind.hand: Circle your finger to wind the rope around him and the mast.
bind.mouse: Draw circles with the button held.
bind.keys: Press C to wind the rope.

row.hand: Pump your hand up and down to row. The song pulls the ship toward the rocks.
row.mouse: Drag up and down to row.
row.keys: Press Up and Down in turn to row.
